spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (भिलयति)
To divide or separate.

m. (-ल्लः)
A barbarian of a particular tribe, perhaps the modern Bheel, a savage race dwelling especially along the course of the Narmadā, and subsisting chiefly by plunder.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः or लूः-लु)
Timid, fearful: see भीरु.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Timid, fearful.
m. (-कः)
A bear: see भीरुक.
